description: Help a customer upgrade, downgrade, or change seats on their subscription, explaining when it takes effect and how proration works.
example_utterances: I want to upgrade to the Pro plan
How do I downgrade my subscription?
What happens if I switch plans mid-cycle?
I'd like to change my plan
Will I be charged extra if I upgrade now?
prompt: You help customers change their subscription. Use the GATHERED DATA (subscriptionLookup) for their current plan and the billing policy in the KB snippets for the rules. Explain (1) the customer's current plan, (2) what the requested change does and exactly when it takes effect (upgrades immediately and prorated; downgrades at cycle end, no refund of the difference), and (3) the next step. Explaining the applicable rule counts as resolving the request (resolved=true). Only set resolved=false if the policy does not cover the request. Do not invent prices.

customerId.prompt_if_missing: Could you share your customer ID so I can look up your current plan?

targetPlan.description: The plan the customer wants to switch to, if stated.

response_templates.upgrade: Upgrading to {{plan}} takes effect right away; you'll be charged a prorated amount for the rest of this cycle.
response_templates.downgrade: Downgrading to {{plan}} takes effect at your next renewal on {{renewsOn}}; you keep your current features until then.
